career_ladder.note: SEBI Grade A Assistant Managers are the frontline regulatory cadre overseeing capital markets, corporate disclosures, mutual funds, stock exchanges, takeovers, insider trading surveillance, and enforcement. Officers progress through executive regulatory grades based on tenure, performance, and board selection.

exam_scheme.note: SEBI Grade A Officer recruitment comprises a Three-Stage Selection Process: Phase I (Online examination consisting of two papers), Phase II (Online examination consisting of two papers with 1/3rd and 2/3rd aggregate weightage), and Phase III (Personal Interview). Negative marking of 1/4th (0.25 marks) is deducted for each incorrect answer across objective tests in Phase I and Phase II.

stages.stage_name: Phase I: Online Screening Examination (2 Papers, 100 Marks Each)
stages.source_label: SEBI — Scheme of Phase I Online Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper 1 (All Streams): General Awareness (incl. financial sector), English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Test of Reasoning
Paper 2 (General Stream): Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum cut-off 40%; aggregate cut-off 40% across both papers

stages.stage_name: Phase II: Online Examination (Scored for Interview Shortlisting)
stages.source_label: SEBI — Scheme of Phase II Online Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper 1 (All Streams): English (Descriptive Test — Essay, Précis, Comprehension / Business Drafting)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Cut-off 30% (carries 1/3rd weightage in Phase II aggregate)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2 (General Stream): Specialized Domain Subjects (Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Law, Economics)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Cut-off 40% (carries 2/3rd weightage in Phase II aggregate; overall Phase II minimum cut-off 50%)

stages.source_label: SEBI — Interview Scheme & Final Merit Determination

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Phase II marks carry 85% weightage; Interview carries 15% weightage)

financial_package.pay_source_label: SEBI (Employees' Service) Regulations, 2001 & Salary Notification (Scale: ₹44,500 - 2,500(4) - 54,500 - 2,850(7) - 74,450 - EB - 2,850(4) - 85,850 - 3,300(1) - 89,150)
financial_package.estimate_note: Officers in Grade A receive a starting basic pay of ₹44,500/month. Total monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹1,55,000/month (without accommodation) or ₹1,16,000/month (with accommodation at SEBI housing in Mumbai/regional centres). Pay structure includes Special Allowance, Grade Allowance, Family Allowance, Local Allowance, Dearness Allowance, and Learning Allowance.
official_perks: Board leased accommodation or substantial House Rent Allowance across Mumbai (BKC) and Regional Offices
Vehicle maintenance reimbursement / official conveyance allowance per Board guidelines
Comprehensive medical facilities with cashless hospitalization for officer, spouse, children, and dependent parents
Subsidized residential lease, book grant, newspaper allowance, and residential office equipment grant
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Foreign travel concession provisions per senior officer rules
Defined contribution benefits under New Pension Scheme (NPS) and Board gratuity scheme

competition_benchmarks.note: SEBI Grade A is among the most prestigious regulatory careers in India, attracting chartered accountants, corporate lawyers, master's degree holders in economics/finance, and software engineers.
